items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And uh, played together around about three or four years.

ctx.x: They had a band up, him and Lawrence and them. Tall Boom and the first started children they all had a band up you know.
Family huh? Yeah, they had a fella called Bush playing trumpet. Bush Hall.
And uh, played together around about three or four years. And after that was, made split the band up with different bands you know.
